title: 2020 年 12 月英语六级真题（第 1 套）

analysis.topic: 青藏铁路的建设意义与影响
analysis.reference: The Qinghai-Tibet Railway is the world's highest and longest plateau railway, stretching 1,956 kilometers in total length, of which 960 kilometers are at an altitude of over 4,000 meters. It is the first railway connecting Tibet with other parts of China. As the railway traverses the world's most fragile ecosystem, ecological conservation measures have been taken both during and after its construction to ensure that it becomes a "green railway." The Qinghai-Tibet Railway has significantly shortened the travel time between the Chinese mainland and Tibet. More importantly, it has greatly boosted the economic development of Tibet and improved the living standards of local residents. Since the opening of the railway, an increasing number of people have chosen to travel to Tibet by train, which also offers them the opportunity to enjoy the spectacular scenery along the route.

sentences.cn: 青藏铁路是世界上最高最长的高原铁路，全长1 956公里，其中有960公里在海拔4 000多米之上，是连接西藏和中国其他地区的第一条铁路。
sentences.en: The Qinghai-Tibet Railway is the world's highest and longest plateau railway, stretching 1,956 kilometers in total length, of which 960 kilometers are at an altitude of over 4,000 meters. It is the first railway connecting Tibet with other parts of China.
sentences.structure: 主系表结构 + 现在分词短语作伴随状语 + of which 引导非限制性定语从句 + 现在分词短语作后置定语
keys: 青藏铁路 the Qinghai-Tibet Railway
高原铁路 plateau railway
全长 in total length / with a total length of
海拔 at an altitude of
连接西藏和中国其他地区 connecting Tibet with other parts of China

sentences.cn: 由于铁路穿越世界上最脆弱的生态系统，在建设期间和建成后都采取了生态保护措施，以确保其成为一条"绿色铁路"。
sentences.en: As the railway traverses the world's most fragile ecosystem, ecological conservation measures have been taken both during and after its construction to ensure that it becomes a "green railway."
sentences.structure: As 引导原因状语从句 + 被动语态主句 + both...and... 并列结构 + to do 不定式表目的
keys: 穿越 traverse
最脆弱的生态系统 the most fragile ecosystem
生态保护措施 ecological conservation measures
建设期间和建成后 both during and after its construction
绿色铁路 green railway

sentences.cn: 青藏铁路大大缩短了中国内地与西藏之间的旅行时间。
sentences.en: The Qinghai-Tibet Railway has significantly shortened the travel time between the Chinese mainland and Tibet.
sentences.structure: 主谓宾结构，现在完成时表示持续至今的影响
keys: 大大缩短 significantly shortened
中国内地 the Chinese mainland
旅行时间 travel time

sentences.cn: 更重要的是，它极大地促进了西藏的经济发展，改善了当地居民的生活。
sentences.en: More importantly, it has greatly boosted the economic development of Tibet and improved the living standards of local residents.
sentences.structure: 插入语 + 主语 + 并列谓语（and 连接两个动词短语），现在完成时
keys: 更重要的是 more importantly
极大地促进 greatly boosted / greatly promoted
经济发展 economic development
当地居民 local residents
改善生活 improved the living standards

sentences.cn: 铁路开通后，愈来愈多的人选择乘火车前往西藏，这样还有机会欣赏沿线的美景。
sentences.en: Since the opening of the railway, an increasing number of people have chosen to travel to Tibet by train, which also offers them the opportunity to enjoy the spectacular scenery along the route.
sentences.structure: Since 引导时间状语 + 主句（现在完成时）+ which 引导非限制性定语从句指代前面整件事
keys: 铁路开通后 since the opening of the railway
愈来愈多的人 an increasing number of people
乘火车前往 travel to...by train
沿线的美景 the spectacular scenery along the route

pitfalls: "全长1956公里"不可译为 the total long is...，应使用 stretching/with a total length of 等结构
"海拔4000多米"中"多"易漏译，须用 over/above/more than 4,000 meters 体现
"建设期间和建成后"时态需注意，adopt 和 take 均可搭配 measures，但不可说 make measures
"愈来愈多的"不宜只写 more and more（略口语化），建议 an increasing number of
"欣赏沿线的美景"中 scenery 为不可数名词，不可加 -s；along the route 不可遗漏

upgrades.note: 分词短语作伴随状语，避免短句罗列，句式更紧凑流畅
boost 比 promote 更生动有力，体现"极大促进"的力度
书面语色彩更浓，更符合六级翻译的正式文体要求
spectacular 更具画面感，体现高原景色的壮美与震撼
用副词 significantly 修饰动词 shortened，表达更精炼地道
